questions.question: Region, Availability Zone va edge location farqi?
questions.explanation: Region — geografik hudud (eu-central-1), mustaqil. AZ — region ichidagi alohida data center(lar), past latency bilan ulangan; HA uchun kamida 2 AZ. Edge location — CloudFront/Route 53 uchun foydalanuvchiga yaqin nuqtalar.

questions.question: EC2 nima va instance type'lar qanday tanlanadi?
questions.explanation: EC2 — virtual server. Type = oila + avlod + o'lcham (`t3.micro`, `m7i.large`, `c7g.xlarge`): t — burstable, m — umumiy, c — CPU, r — xotira, g suffiksi — Graviton (ARM, arzonroq).

questions.question: S3 nima, qanday asosiy xususiyatlari bor?
questions.explanation: S3 — object storage: bucket ichida key → object. Cheksiz hajm, 11 nines durability, HTTP API. Fayl tizimi emas (rename/append yo'q). Storage class'lar (Standard, IA, Glacier) va lifecycle bilan narx optimallashtiriladi.

questions.question: IAM: user, group, role, policy farqi?
questions.explanation: User — odam yoki (eski usulda) dastur uchun doimiy credential; group — user'lar to'plami; role — vaqtinchalik credential beradigan identity, servis/odam 'assume' qiladi; policy — JSON ruxsatlar (Action, Resource, Effect, Condition).

questions.question: VPC, subnet (public/private), Internet Gateway va NAT Gateway nima?
questions.explanation: VPC — izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmoq (CIDR). Public subnet — route table'da Internet Gateway'ga yo'l bor. Private subnet — tashqariga faqat NAT Gateway orqali chiqadi, tashqaridan kirib bo'lmaydi. DB va ilovalar private'da.

questions.question: Security Group va Network ACL farqi?
questions.explanation: Security Group — instance/ENI darajasida, stateful (javob trafik avtomatik ruxsat), faqat allow qoidalar. NACL — subnet darajasida, stateless (kirish va chiqish alohida), allow va deny, tartib raqami bilan.

questions.question: Shared responsibility model nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud provider — cloud'ning **o'zi** uchun javobgar (data center, hardware, hypervisor, managed servis infratuzilmasi). Mijoz — cloud **ichidagi** narsalar uchun: IAM, ma'lumot, shifrlash sozlamalari, OS patch (EC2'da), security group, ilova.

questions.question: AWS CLI'ni qanday sozlaysiz: profile, credential, SSO?
questions.explanation: `aws configure sso` (tavsiya) yoki `aws configure` (access key). Profile'lar `~/.aws/config` va `~/.aws/credentials`da; `--profile` yoki `AWS_PROFILE` bilan tanlanadi. Kim ekanligingizni `aws sts get-caller-identity` ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: EBS, EFS va S3 farqi?
questions.explanation: EBS — bitta EC2'ga ulanadigan blok disk (bitta AZ); EFS — ko'p instance bir vaqtda mount qiladigan NFS fayl tizimi (multi-AZ); S3 — HTTP orqali object storage, cheksiz, mount qilinmaydi (odatda).

questions.question: Route 53 asoslari: hosted zone, record turlari, alias?
questions.explanation: Route 53 — AWS DNS. Hosted zone — domen yozuvlari to'plami; record'lar: A/AAAA (IP), CNAME (boshqa nom), MX, TXT. Alias — AWS resursiga (ALB, CloudFront, S3) ishora qiluvchi maxsus A record, apex domenda ham ishlaydi va bepul so'rovlar.

questions.question: Auto Scaling Group nima va Launch Template bilan qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: ASG — EC2 instance'lar sonini min/desired/max oralig'ida ushlab turadi: o'lgan instance'ni almashtiradi (self-healing) va metrikaga qarab scale qiladi. Launch Template — yangi instance qanday yaratilishi (AMI, type, SG, user data).

questions.question: ECR nima va image'ni ECR'ga qanday push qilasiz?
questions.explanation: ECR — AWS'ning private Docker/OCI registry'si: IAM bilan kirish, image scanning, lifecycle policy (eski image'larni tozalash). EKS/ECS node'lar IAM role bilan pull qiladi.

questions.question: SQS, SNS va EventBridge farqi?
questions.explanation: SQS — navbat (queue): bitta iste'molchi guruhi xabarni tortib oladi, buffer va retry. SNS — pub/sub: bitta xabar ko'p obunachiga (SQS, Lambda, email) push. EventBridge — event bus: qoida (pattern) bo'yicha routing, AWS servis va SaaS event'lari, schedule.

questions.question: ECS va Fargate nima, EKS'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: ECS — AWS'ning o'z container orchestrator'i (task definition, service), oddiy. Fargate — serverless compute: EC2 node boshqarmasdan container ishlatish (ECS yoki EKS bilan). EKS — managed Kubernetes: ekotizim va portativlik, lekin murakkabroq.

questions.question: AWS Secrets Manager va SSM Parameter Store farqi?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi ham secret/config saqlaydi (KMS bilan shifrlangan). Secrets Manager — avtomatik rotation (RDS bilan), cross-region replika, pullik har secret uchun. Parameter Store — oddiy config va secret uchun arzon/bepul (standard), rotation yo'q.

questions.question: ALB va NLB farqi? Qachon qaysi biri?
questions.explanation: ALB — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS): path/host routing, TLS termination, WAF, gRPC. NLB — L4 (TCP/UDP/TLS): juda past latency, statik IP, client IP saqlanadi, millionlab ulanish. HTTP API uchun ALB, TCP protokollar (DB proxy, MQTT, gaming) uchun NLB.

questions.question: RDS nima beradi va backup/HA qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: RDS — managed PostgreSQL/MySQL: patching, backup, monitoring AWS'da. Automated backup + PITR (retention 1-35 kun), snapshot'lar. Multi-AZ — boshqa AZ'da sinxron standby, avtomatik failover (~1-2 daqiqa). Read replica — asinxron, o'qishni scale qilish uchun.

questions.question: CloudWatch nima: metrics, logs, alarms?
questions.explanation: CloudWatch — AWS'ning monitoring xizmati: servis metrikalari (EC2 CPU, ALB 5xx, RDS connections), log group'lar, alarm'lar (SNS orqali xabar yoki autoscaling). EC2 ichki metrikalari (memory, disk) uchun CloudWatch agent kerak.

questions.question: AWS'da xarajatni (cost) nazorat qilish uchun junior nimalarni bilishi kerak?
questions.explanation: Budget va billing alert, tag'lar (team/env), unutilgan resurslar (to'xtatilgan EC2 EBS'i, eski snapshot, bog'lanmagan Elastic IP, bo'sh LB), NAT GW va cross-AZ/egress trafik, log retention, to'g'ri o'lcham va Savings Plans.

questions.question: EC2'dagi app S3'ga qanday kirishi kerak? Access key'ni serverga qo'yish nega yomon?
questions.explanation: IAM role (instance profile) — vaqtinchalik, avtomatik aylanadigan credential IMDS orqali. Statik access key oqib ketadi, aylantirilmaydi, kimniki ekani noaniq. K8s'da IRSA / EKS Pod Identity.

questions.question: Private subnet'dagi instance internetga chiqa olmayapti. Nimalarni tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Route table (0.0.0.0/0 → NAT Gateway), NAT Gateway public subnet'da va uning route'i IGW'ga, Security Group outbound, NACL (stateless — ephemeral portlar), DNS.

questions.question: Lambda qachon mos va qachon mos emas?
questions.explanation: Mos: event-driven, qisqa (≤15 daqiqa), notekis yuk (S3 event, SQS, cron, kichik API) — server boshqaruvi yo'q, ishlatilganicha to'lov. Mos emas: uzoq jarayonlar, doimiy yuqori yuk (qimmatroq), past latency talabi (cold start), ko'p DB ulanishi, katta state.

questions.question: Secrets Manager va SSM Parameter Store farqi?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi config/secret saqlaydi, KMS bilan shifrlaydi, IAM bilan cheklanadi. Secrets Manager — avtomatik rotation (RDS bilan integratsiya), cross-account, pullik (secret boshiga). Parameter Store — arzon/bepul (standard), oddiy config va secret'lar uchun, rotation yo'q.

questions.question: AWS Organizations va SCP nima? Multi-account strategiya nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Organizations — ko'p account'ni markaziy boshqarish (billing, OU'lar). SCP (Service Control Policy) — account'lar uchun ruxsatlarning yuqori chegarasi: hatto account admin'i ham SCP taqiqlagan amalni qila olmaydi. Account — eng kuchli izolyatsiya (blast radius, billing, limitlar).

questions.question: CloudTrail, GuardDuty va AWS Config — har biri nima uchun?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail — 'kim, qachon, qaysi API'ni chaqirdi' audit logi. GuardDuty — tahdidlarni aniqlash (g'alati API faoliyati, crypto-miner, kompromat credential). Config — resurslar konfiguratsiyasi tarixi va qoidalarga muvofiqlik (masalan, 'S3 public bo'lmasin').

questions.question: VPC peering, Transit Gateway va PrivateLink farqi?
questions.explanation: Peering — ikki VPC'ni to'g'ridan bog'lash (tranzitiv emas, CIDR kesishmasligi kerak). Transit Gateway — hub: ko'p VPC va on-prem'ni markaziy marshrutlash. PrivateLink — bitta servisni (NLB ortidagi) boshqa VPC'ga xususiy endpoint sifatida berish, tarmoqlarni to'liq ulamasdan.

questions.question: Kimdir prod Security Group'da 22-portni `0.0.0.0/0` ga ochib qo'ydi. Qanday aniqlaysiz, tuzatasiz va oldini olasiz?
questions.explanation: Darhol qoidani olib tashlash, CloudTrail'dan kim/qachon (AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress), shu oraliqda SSH kirishlarini tekshirish. Oldini olish: SSH o'rniga SSM Session Manager, AWS Config qoidasi bilan avtomatik remediation, IaC'dan tashqari o'zgarishni taqiqlash.

questions.question: S3 bucket'dagi ma'lumotga ruxsatsiz kirilganiga shubha bor. Qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail data events (GetObject) yoki S3 server access log'lari — kim (principal), qaysi IP, qaysi obyekt. Bucket policy, ACL, presigned URL, oqib ketgan access key'ni tekshirish. Keyin: kalitni o'chirish, Block Public Access, policy'ni toraytirish.

questions.question: EKS'da pod'ga AWS ruxsatini qanday berasiz: IRSA va EKS Pod Identity?
questions.explanation: Node IAM role'ini hamma pod ulashsa — least privilege buziladi. IRSA: ServiceAccount annotation + OIDC provider, pod web identity token bilan role'ni assume qiladi. Pod Identity (yangi): EKS agent orqali, OIDC sozlamasiz, association API bilan — ko'p klasterda oddiyroq.

questions.question: Ko'p AZ'li yuqori mavjudlikdagi (HA) web arxitekturani AWS'da qanday qurasiz?
questions.explanation: ALB (ko'p AZ) → ASG yoki EKS (kamida 2-3 AZ) → RDS Multi-AZ + read replica, ElastiCache, S3 + CloudFront. Har AZ'da NAT GW. Stateless app, health check, backup va DR rejasi.

questions.question: Senariy: AWS access key GitHub'ga oqib ketdi va kimdir EC2'larda crypto-miner ishga tushirdi. Incident response tartibi?
questions.explanation: Containment birinchi: kalitni darhol deactivate qiling, sessiyalarni bekor qiling (inline deny policy `aws:TokenIssueTime`), begona resurslarni to'xtating (snapshot olib). Keyin CloudTrail bilan ko'lamni aniqlash, persistence (yangi IAM user/role, kalitlar) qidirish, tozalash, AWS Support bilan billing.

questions.question: Senariy: RDS CPU 100%, ilova sekin. Birinchi qadamlar va uzoq muddatli yechim?
questions.explanation: Avval qaysi so'rov yuklayotganini toping (Performance Insights / `pg_stat_activity`, `pg_stat_statements`), yangi deploy yoki trafik o'zgarishi bilan bog'lang. Tez choralar: og'ir so'rovni to'xtatish, feature flag, read replica'ga o'qishni ko'chirish. Keyin: indeks/so'rov tuzatish, connection pooling, kerak bo'lsa instance kattalashtirish.

questions.question: Senariy: bitta AZ ishdan chiqdi. Arxitekturangiz omon qoldimi — nimalarni oldindan tekshirgan bo'lishingiz kerak?
questions.explanation: Har qatlam kamida 2-3 AZ'da va qolgan AZ'lar to'liq yukni ko'tara oladimi (N+1 sig'im): ALB, ASG/node group'lar, NAT GW har AZ'da, RDS Multi-AZ, ElastiCache replica boshqa AZ'da, EBS'ga bog'liq stateful pod'lar. Game day bilan amalda sinalgan bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: Cloud xarajati yiliga 40% o'syapti. FinOps jarayonini qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Ko'rinish (tag/account bo'yicha xarajat egasi), mas'uliyat (jamoalar o'z budjeti va unit cost'ini ko'radi), optimallashtirish (rightsizing, commitments, arxitektura) va boshqaruv (budget alert, policy). Maqsad xarajatni kamaytirish emas, unit economics (1 buyurtma narxi) ni nazorat qilish.
